description: Shell script for managing and viewing logs for the VibeTunnel/OpenClaw project. Provides logging filtering, formatting, and streaming capabilities tailored to the macOS unified logging system.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays instructions when sudo password errors occur, guiding user to configure passwordless sudo for Apple log access.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the clawlog utility.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and displays recent log categories for the VibeTunnel logs.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user input for safe inclusion in macOS log predicates.
